description: Show any text (a positioning statement, feature description, error message, instructions or an announcement) to simulated people and hear how they react. Pass goal to say what the text should achieve. Returns each person's reaction, objections and what would help. With a key, the result ends with a link to the full report in the Mimiq app.

audience.description: Who the simulated people should be, in plain words, e.g. "startup founders in SF" or "parents shopping for kids toys". If omitted, Mimiq picks the likely audience from the content.

goal.description: What the text should achieve, e.g. "get people to update their card".

name: mimiq.test_text
